title: coap_location_beacon host test cannot build: Kconfig RING_BUFFER tangle (CONFIG_COAP_SERVER/SLIP)
description: Pre-existing build breakage blocking lichen/tests/coap_location_beacon (found while wiring l1qw.32(b)'s 4.01 body): native_sim configure fails in Kconfig with '...depends again on RING_BUFFER (defined at lib/utils/Kconfig:12)' tracing through the LICHEN SLIP transport Kconfig (lichen/subsys/lichen/transport/Kconfig:14 depends on RING_BUFFER; :203 for KISS). The prj.conf combination (CONFIG_COAP_SERVER=y, CONFIG_SLIP=n, CONFIG_TEST_RANDOM_GENERATOR=y also unresolvable on native_sim without an entropy driver) cannot configure on Zephyr 4.1.0. The same tree builds routing_dispatch fine. Fix the Kconfig structure (likely a duplicated/late RING_BUFFER dependency in the LICHEN transport Kconfig or the prj.conf symbol set) so the location host test can run; needed by l1qw.32(b) verification.
close_reason: coap_location_beacon host test now builds and runs on native_sim/native/64. Root cause: coap_location.c calls four OSCORE functions (coap_oscore_send_protected, coap_oscore_authorize_mutating, coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request, coap_oscore_respond_resource) but the test's stub set only covered the latter two — send_protected and authorize_mutating had no stubs, causing the link failures. Fixes: (1) src/main.c adds coap_oscore_send_protected stub (always 0 = success) and coap_oscore_authorize_mutating stub (always -ENOTSUP = unauthorized, outputs zero-initialized) matching the real coap_oscore.h signatures exactly; (2) Kconfig/prj.conf left as-is — the build now configures cleanly (the RING_BUFFER trace in the original report does not reproduce; routing_dispatch and this test both configure on the current shared workspace). Verification: native_sim/native/64 build green, ztest run 29/29 PASS (0 failures) with sanitizers per the extra_conf_files chain landed for the sibling tests, two consecutive runs stable. Codereview delegated to kimi-k3 (consolidated): stub signatures verified against coap_oscore.h (addr non-const fix), zero-init outputs before -ENOTSUP return verified, test isolation confirmed (stateless stubs, no globals). Note: the test's prj.conf sets CONFIG_TEST_RANDOM_GENERATOR=y which the original report flagged as unresolvable — it resolves on the current shared workspace (TEST_RANDOM_GENERATOR was likely the RING_BUFFER-confusion symptom, now moot). Residual: prj.conf keeps CONFIG_SLIP=n and LICHEN_COAP=n deliberately (the test stubs OSCORE itself); if a future change needs real SLIP/OSCORE in this test, the stubs must be dropped first.
